QUOTE: "It is the standard two-phase sizing pattern for C APIs that cannot allocate for you." and "The second call runs unconditionally. It does not repeat on failure, so it is not retry."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes it is a size probe/fill (size negotiation), not retry, and notes exactly two calls with the second unconditional. It never explicitly says "no backoff/delay/counter", but the substance is covered.
